programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Builder Chase Morrill, along with Ashley Morrill-Eldridge and Ryan Eldridge, his sister and brother-in-law, transform cabins in some of the most beautiful areas of Maine. From historic cottages to camp cabins, scenic retreats get the facelifts they need.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: A family finds their camp flooded when they return after winter; as the team pull back what remains of the floor, problems compound as they find powder post beetles, dry rot and more.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The crew tackles a custom build for an architect -- complete with framing challenges, snowmobile chaos and a dog house that just won't stay in the truck; with big beams, laughs and a trip back to school.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The team honors grandfather Bampy Hersom's memory by continuing renovations on his cabin and creating a bigger bathroom and kitchen.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The team takes on a rebuild for a family after a devastating storm destroys their camp; with five decades of memories to honor and a vision for a larger space, the crew battles freezing temperatures and a ticking clock to finish the cabin in time.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The team takes on a family's 1800s cabin that has a personal connection to Chase and Ashley; it was previously renovated by their dad, Eric; they follow his lead by refurbishing the landscape, adding a bathroom and making better use of the space.
